name: Market Capture
summary: Market Capture is a breakout-based Expert Advisor that identifies periods of market consolidation and enters trades when price breaks out of the captured range. It aims to capture significant directional moves following periods of low volatility and range-bound price action, using defined entry and exit rules based on range expansion.
summary_zh: Market Capture是一个基于突破的EA，它识别市场盘整期，并在价格突破所捕获的区间时入场交易。该EA旨在捕捉低波动率和横盘整理后出现的显著方向性行情，使用基于区间扩展的明确入场和出场规则。
strategy_analysis: Market Capture策略的核心概念是捕获市场在盘整期间形成的价格区间，并在突破发生时入场。入场条件基于价格突破先前定义的区间高低点，当价格向上突破区间上轨时做多，向下突破区间下轨时做空。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损或跟踪止损来锁定利润。仓位管理方面，该EA支持手数设置，可能根据账户余额或风险比例进行仓位调整。资金管理方面，通过止损来控制单笔交易风险，但需要关注是否对多重突破进行了过滤以避免假突破。整体策略逻辑清晰，属于经典的区间突破交易方法，但在震荡市中可能面临频繁止损的风险。
strategy_analysis_en: The core concept of the Market Capture strategy is to identify price ranges formed during market consolidation periods and enter trades upon breakout. Entry conditions are based on price breaking above the defined range high for long positions or below the range low for short positions. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels, or trailing stops to lock in profits as the move develops. Position sizing supports configurable lot sizes and may adjust based on account balance or risk percentage parameters. Money management is handled through stop-loss controls to limit per-trade risk, though the effectiveness of false breakout filtering varies. The overall strategy logic is clear and follows a classic range breakout trading methodology, but it may face frequent stop-outs in choppy, non-trending markets where breakouts fail to sustain directional momentum.

parameters.name: LotSize
parameters.description_en: Fixed lot size (used when MMRec disabled)

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points, typically set at gap close

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，区间突破是经过长期验证的经典交易方法
使用固定止损和止盈，风险可控且易于回测验证
跟踪止損功能可以在趋势行情中有效锁定利润
参数化设计允许交易者根据不同品种和市场条件进行优化调整
pros_en: Clear and well-defined strategy logic based on the proven range breakout methodology
Fixed stop-loss and take-profit provide defined risk management and easy backtesting
Trailing stop feature effectively locks in profits during trending market conditions
Parameterized design allows traders to optimize settings for different instruments and market conditions
cons: 在震荡市中容易遭遇假突破导致频繁止损，胜率可能较低
区间识别方法可能过于简单，未考虑波动率变化和市场结构
缺乏多重时间框架确认和成交量验证，突破信号可靠性有限
仓位管理可能不够灵活，未支持基于ATR的动态止损止盈
cons_en: Vulnerable to false breakouts in choppy markets leading to frequent stop-outs and low win rate
Range identification method may be overly simplistic without accounting for volatility changes or market structure
Lacks multi-timeframe confirmation and volume validation, limiting breakout signal reliability
Position sizing may lack flexibility without ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit support
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈和仓位计算，适应不同市场波动率
加入多时间框架确认和成交量过滤，提高突破信号的可靠性
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss, take-profit, and position sizing to adapt to varying market volatility
Implement multi-timeframe confirmation and volume filtering to improve breakout signal reliability

risk_points: 假突破风险：在低波动或震荡市场中可能频繁触发止损
固定止损可能不适合所有品种，低波动品种止损过宽而高波动品种止损过窄
risk_points_en: False breakout risk: frequent stop-loss triggers likely in low-volatility or choppy markets
Fixed stop-loss may not suit all instruments—too wide for low-volatility and too narrow for high-volatility pairs

It aims to capture significant directional moves following periods of low volatility and range-bound price action, using defined entry and exit rules based on range expansion.
